name: planta-77
description: Your Claude Code sessions as characters on a cyberpunk office floor you can fly around: /office is the floor with one room per project and /cameras is the security room with a camera per room, live traces and the system load

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane, the commands and the messages

party_desks.title: Desks for sessions at the party
party_desks.description: Keep an empty desk in their room for sessions that are in the bunker (between 14 hours and 3 days without use)

ai_grouping.title: Group projects with AI
ai_grouping.description: Ask Haiku to put folders of the same project together; it only asks again when a new folder appears

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh
refresh_seconds.description: Seconds between updates while the pane is open

container_prefix.title: Container prefix
container_prefix.description: Optional prefix to drop from Docker container names in the server room, such as the compose project name

wheel_zoom.title: Zoom with the mouse wheel
wheel_zoom.description: Turn the wheel into zoom at the pointer. Turn it off if the pane jumps when you scroll; the + and − buttons and keys always work

compat_mode.title: Compatible mode
compat_mode.description: Draw the floor as a still picture without camera movement. The mod switches to it by itself if the app refuses the live view
